'''Yav Yiyar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of the [[Yiyar clan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was number two in the [[Yiyar Salvage Corporation]] and hoped to find the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] lost just after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He owned the ''[[Nightflyer]]'', a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]].
